sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 56 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

review.note: Approximate visual pavement-edge reads, not surveyed road limits. Dense fitted samples are not additional independent observations. The rejected automatic proposal was not accepted or used as an independent measurement recipe. Native licensed pixels remain outside the repository. The same existing public layout GeoJSON contains all accepted reconstruction data; this shared research record preserves the replaced original data for review. Curbs remain illustrative and banking unknown.
review.roadLevels: GSI DEM5A samples at final paired midpoints, with separately interpolated upper and occluded lower approach intervals. No nominal bridge height.

video.note: Reviewed complete-lap samples and every quarter-second sample from 15 to 20.75 seconds. The fixed-height chase recording was rejected because the deck hid the car. The corrected chase mount lowers smoothly below explicit elevated road sections and keeps the car visible through this underpass. Video and meshes are generated on demand, not stored in track data.
